spans.text: AK-12, you haven't forgotten your own specialty, have you?
Which one are you referring to?
We'll need to deal with those military units if we want to pass through here. The best way is to assume direct control over them.
It's possible, given the present circumstances. But I'll need some help for this.
See those radar stations there? I need you to capture them so I can hack into the military units.
Those radar stations, huh...Got it, I'll inform M4A1.
Also, I can't tell exactly which military units I'll be able to reach from any particular radar station. It's all a matter of luck.
Beggars can't be choosers. Leave the radar stations to us. You take care of the rest.
